title: Static Ad Creative Spec
description: Strict, backend-agnostic specification for a single static performance-ad creative. Strategy is decided here BEFORE any image model is called. The image backend never invents marketing strategy.

creative_id.description: Stable, filesystem-safe id. Convention: <angle>-<nn>, e.g. pain-agitation-01.

platform.description: Distribution platform. 'meta' covers Facebook + Instagram; 'reddit' covers Reddit promoted-post image creative.

placement.description: Surface inside the platform. Must be consistent with platform and aspect_ratio (see references/platform-specs.md).

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio as 'W:H' (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.91:1). Any ratio from 1:3 to 3:1 is supported and sized automatically for gpt-image-2. Common ad ratios — Meta feed: 1:1, 4:5, 1.91:1; Meta story/reels: 9:16; Reddit feed: 1:1, 4:5, 1.91:1. One creative can be rendered at several ratios via the generator's --aspect-ratio flag. See references/platform-specs.md.

goal.description: Primary conversion objective this creative is optimized for.

persona.description: Who this speaks to, in their own self-image.

pain.description: The concrete problem state they feel.

desire.description: The end state they actually want.

awareness_level.description: Eugene Schwartz awareness stage. Drives how much the creative must educate vs. close.

angle.description: One of the angles in references/angle-taxonomy.md (e.g. pain_agitation, before_after, fake_ui, founder_confession, community_native, imessage, product_proof, social_proof, comparison, contrarian, meme_native, objection_handling, urgency_offer, transformation).

boldness.description: Recommended but optional. How forcefully the ad should interrupt: soft = safer and more measured, medium = opinionated, hard = intentionally punchy and provocative while still evidence-backed.

disruption_target.description: Recommended but optional. The belief, behavior, old way, or hidden cost this ad attacks.

hook_tactic.description: Recommended but optional. The scroll-stopping frame chosen from references/hook-strategy.md. This is narrower than angle: e.g. angle=product_proof, hook_tactic=contrarian.

psychological_trigger.description: Recommended but optional. The emotional mechanism inside the hook, such as pattern_interrupt, curiosity_gap, myth_busting, pain_agitation, social_proof_credibility, urgency_stakes, or identity_callout.

creative_mechanic.description: Recommended but optional. How the viewer arrives at the truth, such as reframe, contrast_without_comment, implied_answer, social_witness, overheard_conversation, or trojan_horse.

hook.description: The single scroll-stopping idea, in the audience's language.

claim_support.description: Recommended but optional. The concrete proof that makes the hook fair: demo, stat, screenshot, sourced quote, price math, comparison, objection reply, or real offer.

objection_addressed.description: The specific doubt this creative defuses.

proof_type.description: The form of evidence carrying the claim.

template.description: A template id from references/visual-templates.md (e.g. hero_product, before_after_split, stat_card, native_social_post).

style.description: Art direction / aesthetic (e.g. 'candid iPhone UGC, slightly imperfect', 'clean editorial studio').

scene.description: What is literally happening in frame.

subject.description: The primary subject (person, product, UI, object).

composition.description: Framing, rule-of-thirds, negative space for text, shot type.

focal_point.description: The one thing the eye must land on first.

props.description: Supporting objects. Keep the count low (entity-limit rule).

representation.description: How the product appears (packshot, in-hand, on-screen UI, result-only, implied).

must_show.description: Non-negotiable on-brand elements (logo, signature color, real UI label).

must_not_show.description: Hard exclusions: competitor marks, fake third-party logos, fabricated endorsements, off-brand colors, policy-risky imagery.

overlay_text.description: Text BAKED INTO the image. Keep it short enough to read at thumb-stopping speed (see platform-specs.md). Usually this should carry the sharpest, most interruptive expression of the hook.

headline.description: Platform headline field (outside the image). This can be slightly fuller than overlay_text, but should still feel specific and clickable, not generic category copy.

cta.description: Call to action (button label or in-copy).

typography.description: Type direction: weight, case, scale, contrast treatment for legibility.

safe_zones.description: Areas to keep clear of platform UI chrome (see platform-specs.md).

final_image_prompt.description: The art-directed scene description (no strategy invention). The prompt compiler wraps this with structural directives; may be left empty for the compiler to synthesize from visual.*.

negative_constraints.description: Things to avoid (garbled text, extra fingers, fake logos, busy backgrounds).

reference_images.description: Local paths/URLs of reference/brand images for image-to-image (used via the edits endpoint).

readability_check.description: Verdict on whether the hook reads in-feed at thumbnail size.

native_platform_check.description: Verdict on whether it looks native vs. like an ad.

policy_risks.description: Flagged policy concerns from references/policy-checks.md (empty array = none found).

iteration_notes.description: What to try next / known weaknesses.
